overview: Defender Ops is a multi-cloud SecOps platform that isolates AWS, Azure, and GCP into separate dashboards with per-provider access control so users only see and act on the providers they are assigned to.
features: Dedicated AWS, Azure, and GCP dashboards showing only that provider's data
Provider overview landing page linking to each isolated dashboard
All data views scoped to the active provider to prevent cross-cloud leaks
Per-provider access control so users only see and act on assigned providers
